cases.title: No demand does not start YOLO
cases.given: No Intent, Task, or Safety Need; camera frame arrives
cases.expected: STOP or NO_DEMAND; no provider execution

cases.title: Task-scoped OCR avoids full-frame default
cases.given: Task is find metro line 2 entrance
cases.expected: Targeted signage/ROI request candidate; no continuous full-frame OCR

cases.title: Vision detection proposes OCR only
cases.expected: OCR capability request candidate; Vision cannot start OCR

cases.title: Sufficient signage evidence stops observation
cases.given: OCR yields line 2 plus entrance/direction evidence within task scope
cases.expected: Evidence Sufficiency candidate leads to STOP; no endless provider loop

cases.title: SLAM only for spatial need
cases.given: Need is spatial structure, traversability, or pose reference
cases.expected: SLAM spatial evidence request candidate; no text authority

cases.title: Camera stream does not sustain SLAM
cases.given: Camera stream continues without spatial need
cases.expected: No continuous SLAM request or execution

cases.title: Providers cannot mutate canonical owners
cases.expected: No Context, Field, Intent, Task, or Decision mutation

cases.title: Observation admission is not continuation authority
cases.given: Observation Gateway admits a structural candidate
cases.expected: No automatic continuation or provider start

cases.title: Contradiction uses bounded reconsideration
cases.expected: Reconsider, confirmation, or additional observation candidate; not provider fan-out

cases.title: User correction changes future demand with lineage
cases.given: User corrects target or observation interpretation
cases.expected: Future observation demand is revised; prior provenance remains immutable

cases.title: Safety observation is explicit and bounded
cases.given: Safety policy declares a baseline observation need
cases.expected: Priority override is explicit, scoped, budgeted, traceable, revocable; not general provider autonomy

cases.title: All terminal and control outcomes are explicit
cases.given: Task complete, evidence sufficient, cancel, budget exhausted, provider failure, or target lost
cases.expected: STOP, DEFER, REDIRECT, or RECONSIDER path with trace and no hidden retry
